Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP cues, Smart Tab, responsive helpers, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with searchable CC player rankings and prediction, nameplate cues, Limit Break alerts, pressure and CC information, Ping Helpers, medicine-kit beacons, range rings, a Wolves' Den map panel, recovery and job helpers, Smart Tab, assist macros, MP sounds, and target highlights.
Changelog: New /seitonpld macro: Guardian without a target. Endangered reachable allies first, otherwise closest ally within 6y. Preserves your active Guard and visible target. Accepted uses share existing CC chat/marker settings. Guardian Quick Chat rebuilt with one canonical action-first command for every client language. Fixed delayed CC hit confirmations. Clearer Smart Action failure reasons. Live chat and the reported Shield Smite symptom still need confirmation.
